title: findings.json: the submit payload and the second argument of score_episode
description: Structure only: what this schema refuses is an invalid submit (episode ends, return -1, the other six metrics null). Everything it accepts is scored; a well-typed finding with an unknown type, a currency differing by case or space, ids that do not exist, an empty affected_ids or a huge amount is a false positive, not a structural error. affected_ids and evidence_ids are sets (order and repeats do not matter) but the 10-id cap is checked on the list as sent. Unknown extra keys are ignored. The validator is genesis_audit.schemas.parse_findings_document.

episode_id.description: Optional. When present it must equal manifest.episode_id (otherwise the submit is invalid).

type.description: One of manifest.issue_types: duplicate_invoice, payment_allocation, fx_mismatch, cutoff. Any other string is unmatched (FP).

affected_ids.description: The issue's canonical affected set (see docs/ADAPTER.md, error types). A set; exact equality is required for a TP.

claimed_amount_minor.description: A JSON integer in minor units of `currency` (not a bool, string or fraction).

currency.description: Exact code as in manifest.currencies; no case folding or trimming.

evidence_ids.description: At most 10 as sent (repeats count). A set; it must include one acceptable evidence set, and every id must be a ledger row_id, a document doc_id or an fx key date|source|target of this episode, else the finding is unmatched.

explanation.description: At most 1000 Unicode code points; not scored.
